context.requirement_text: Test hermeticity bug (first sharded gate run, PR2 #2374, run 37715164184): inside a shard job TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 and TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD=K/3 are ambient; tests that drive the real scripts/test_parallel.sh (stub mix/psql) or call Mix.Tasks.Letflow.Check.Test.run/1 inherit them and fail. Fix: every such test scrubs ambient TEST_PARALLEL_* (and the other script knobs) via the shared helper test/support/test_parallel_env.ex (Letflow.Test.TestParallelEnv), without changing what any test asserts. RED reproduced with TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 TEST_PARALLEL_SHARD=1/3 TEST_PARALLEL_TOTAL=12 TEST_PARALLEL_OFFSET=0: instrumentation_test:178,:191, watchdog_orphan_test:275, letflow_check_test_test:1464 fail.

Already written and committed by ORCH: the helper and test/scripts/test_parallel_env_test.exs (helper unit test) and test/scripts/test_parallel_env_guard_test.exs (guard). Do not edit scripts/ or lib/. Remove now-redundant per-file `{"TEST_PARALLEL_X", nil}` lines only if the helper covers them; do not change assertions. Run every touched file with the ambient shard env AND with none (mix mutex protocol, see below).
